name: cortexmd
description: Persistent second brain for Claude Code: memory store/recall with temperature decay, per-machine agent diaries, Obsidian notes + knowledge graph, and cheap code navigation (~60 tokens per symbol). Wires the cortexmd MCP server plus the full hook template — session wakeup, per-prompt recall, code-nav hints, high-signal command capture, diary on Stop/PreCompact — in one install.

server_url.title: cortexmd server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your running cortexmd server (the MCP endpoint is <url>/mcp). Also exported to every hook as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL, which the hook scripts forward to the cortexmd CLI as --server.

api_key.title: cortexmd API key (optional)
api_key.description: Static Bearer token for servers configured with API_KEY. Leave empty to use OAuth (/mcp in Claude Code, `cortexmd auth oauth-login --server <url>` for the hooks). Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.
